automationNotes: Covers the Enable MFA section of https://www.contentstack.com/docs/developers/security/multi-factor-authentication. Steps mirror the document exactly. Steps after clicking Continue (QR code scanning, TOTP code entry, backup-code handling) require external interaction and are covered with warn actions. Any step that fails means the app does not match the documentation; the documentation must be updated.

steps.target: Profile icon in top-right corner (doc step)

Add or Enable MFA button (doc step)

Continue button in Set Up MFA modal (doc step)
Authenticator App modal with QR code (doc step)
steps.value: External step: A modal window appears with a QR code. Open an authenticator app (e.g., Google Authenticator, Authy) and scan the QR code or manually enter the code displayed under it.

steps.target: Click Next in Authenticator App modal (doc step)
steps.value: External step: Click Next after scanning the QR code.

steps.target: Enter 6-digit TOTP code and click Verify (doc step)
steps.value: External step: Enter the 6-digit verification code generated by your authenticator app and click Verify to complete the setup.

steps.target: Generate backup codes or Skip for Now (doc step)
steps.value: External step: After MFA is enabled, click Generate Backup Codes (recommended) or Skip for Now.

steps.target: Copy or Download backup codes and click Done (doc step)
steps.value: External step: Click Copy codes or Download as .txt file to save your backup codes, then click Done.
